title: Best Live-Action Explainer Video Makers (2026): How to Hire
description: How to hire a live-action explainer video maker: actors, filming, script, how to brief it, what drives the price and red flags.
intro: Live-action explainer videos use real people, filmed on camera, to explain a product, service or process. They feel personal and trustworthy, especially when showing real products, teams or customers. Projects go wrong when the script is too long, the actor does not fit the audience, or usage rights for footage and talent are not agreed. This guide helps you get a clear, credible video.

faq.a: Live-action builds human trust and shows real products. Animation explains abstract ideas and is easier to change later. Some videos combine both.
Professional actors, presenters or your own team. Each choice affects cost, authenticity and usage rights.

faq.q: Do I need to supply the product?
faq.a: Usually yes, if it should appear on camera. Plan shipping and return in the schedule.

faq.q: How long should the video be?
faq.a: Short enough to keep attention, focused on one main message. The script decides the length.

faq.q: Can I use the video in ads?
faq.a: Only if the actor's and music licenses cover ads. Agree on usage, duration and platforms.
